user.title: Bitpanda
user.description: Which service do you want to set up? Each one can be added once.

menu_options.portfolio: Bitpanda Portfolio: your holdings (needs an API key)
menu_options.price_tracker: Bitpanda Price Tracker: prices of any asset (no API key)

portfolio.title: Bitpanda Portfolio
portfolio.description: Enter your Bitpanda API key. Create one at [{api_key_url}]({api_key_url}).

data_description.api_key: The key needs the permissions Guthaben (Balance), Transaktion (Transaction) and Earn (Read); Trading is not needed. Permissions cannot be added to an existing key later.

currency.title: Portfolio currency
currency.description: In which currency do you want to see your portfolio?

data_description.currency: Bitpanda reports every value of your portfolio in this currency. To change it later, open the ⋮ menu of the "Bitpanda Portfolio" entry on the Bitpanda integration page and choose "Reconfigure".

price_tracker.title: Bitpanda Price Tracker
price_tracker.description: Additional currencies are optional; you can also choose them later with "Configure" (⚙) on the "Bitpanda Price Tracker" entry of the Bitpanda integration page. Add assets afterwards with "Add price tracker" on the same entry.

data_description.extra_currencies: Every tracked asset always gets a price sensor in EUR. Each currency selected here adds one more sensor per asset, converted with the daily reference rates of the European Central Bank.

reauth_confirm.title: New Bitpanda API key needed
reauth_confirm.description: Bitpanda rejected the stored API key. It may have expired, or it predates the permissions this version needs. Create a new key at [{api_key_url}]({api_key_url}) and paste it here. Your sensors are kept.

data_description.api_key: The new key needs the permissions Guthaben (Balance), Transaktion (Transaction) and Earn (Read).

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Bitpanda Portfolio
reconfigure.description: Replace the stored API key, change the currency, or both.

data_description.api_key: Leave empty to keep the current key. A new key from [{api_key_url}]({api_key_url}) needs the permissions Guthaben (Balance), Transaktion (Transaction) and Earn (Read).
data_description.currency: Changing the currency deletes all Portfolio sensors including their history; you confirm this in the next step.

confirm_currency.title: Change the currency?
confirm_currency.description: Changing the currency from {old} to {new} deletes all Portfolio sensors including their history and recreates them in the new currency. This cannot be undone. Select "Submit" to continue, or close this dialog to keep {old}.

error.invalid_auth: Bitpanda rejected this API key. Check that it was copied completely and that it has at least one of the required permissions.
error.missing_scopes: This API key is missing permissions: {missing_scopes}. Permissions cannot be added to an existing key. Create a new one with Guthaben (Balance), Transaktion (Transaction) and Earn (Read).
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Bitpanda. Try again later.

abort.all_configured: Both services are already set up.
abort.already_configured: This service is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: This service is already being set up in another dialog.
abort.currency_changed: The currency was changed. The Portfolio sensors are being recreated.
abort.no_reconfigure: The Price Tracker has nothing to reconfigure. Choose its currencies with "Configure" (⚙) on the same entry.
abort.unload_failed: The Portfolio could not be stopped, so the currency was not changed and nothing was deleted. Restart Home Assistant and try again.

price_tracker.title: Price Tracker options
price_tracker.description: Changes apply as soon as you save.

data.language: Language of group titles and messages

data_description.extra_currencies: Every tracked asset always keeps its EUR sensor. Each selected currency adds one sensor per asset; removing a currency deletes those sensors.
data_description.language: Group titles and the integration's own messages use this language. Sensor names follow Home Assistant's system language.

portfolio.title: Portfolio options
portfolio.description: To replace the API key or change the currency, open the ⋮ menu of the "Bitpanda Portfolio" entry on the Bitpanda integration page and choose "Reconfigure".

data.language: Language of group titles and messages

data_description.language: Group titles and the integration's own messages use this language. Sensor names follow Home Assistant's system language.

user.title: Add price tracker
user.description: Which kind of asset do you want to track?

data_description.category: The next step lists every asset of this type that is not tracked yet.

asset.title: Add price tracker
asset.description: Which asset do you want to track?

data_description.asset: Type to search by name, symbol or ISIN, then pick one asset. To go back to the asset types, select "Submit" without picking one.

error.no_assets_available: Every asset of this type is already tracked.
error.unknown_asset: Pick an asset from the list.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Bitpanda. Try again later.

abort.asset_added: {asset} is now tracked in the group {group}.

portfolio_device_not_removable.message: The Portfolio device is part of the Bitpanda Portfolio service and cannot be deleted on its own. To remove it, delete the "Bitpanda Portfolio" entry on the Bitpanda integration page (⋮ → "Delete").

held_wallet_not_removable.message: You still hold {asset}, so this wallet would come straight back. It is removed automatically once you no longer hold it.

update_failed.message: Could not fetch data from Bitpanda.

update_failed_timeout.message: Could not fetch data from Bitpanda: {path} did not answer in time.

update_failed_connection.message: Could not fetch data from Bitpanda: the connection for {path} failed.

update_failed_http_status.message: Could not fetch data from Bitpanda: {path} answered with HTTP status {status}.

update_failed_rate_limited.message: Could not fetch data from Bitpanda: too many requests for {path}.

update_failed_unreadable.message: Could not fetch data from Bitpanda: the answer from {path} could not be read.

update_failed_incomplete_listing.message: Could not fetch data from Bitpanda: the listing from {path} is incomplete.

history_unavailable.message: No portfolio history could be fetched.

portfolio_empty.message: Bitpanda reported an empty portfolio. Until the next answers confirm it, it counts as a glitch and nothing is removed.

prices_rate_limited.message: Bitpanda received too many price requests. Retrying later.

no_prices.message: No prices could be fetched from Bitpanda.

ecb_rates_failed.message: Could not fetch the ECB exchange rates.

ecb_rates_failed_timeout.message: Could not fetch the ECB exchange rates: the ECB did not answer in time.

ecb_rates_failed_connection.message: Could not fetch the ECB exchange rates: the connection to the ECB failed.

ecb_rates_failed_http_status.message: Could not fetch the ECB exchange rates: the ECB answered with HTTP status {status}.

ecb_rates_failed_unreadable.message: Could not fetch the ECB exchange rates: the answer from the ECB could not be read.

nothing_to_refresh.message: There is nothing to refresh: neither Bitpanda Portfolio nor Bitpanda Price Tracker is loaded.

renamed_entities.title: Bitpanda upgrade: entity IDs renamed
renamed_entities.description:
The upgrade to the two services Bitpanda Portfolio and Bitpanda Price Tracker renamed these entity IDs; their history moved with them. Check dashboards, automations and scripts that still use the old IDs:

{entities}

entities_not_migrated.title: Bitpanda upgrade: entities not migrated
entities_not_migrated.description:
The upgrade left these entities unchanged, and they are no longer updated. Delete them once you no longer need them. Fiat wallets may be among them: Portfolio Cash now covers every fiat balance. The Home Assistant log names the reason for each entity.

{entities}

currency_dropped.title: Bitpanda upgrade: Portfolio currency changed to EUR
currency_dropped.description: {currency}, the currency of your Bitpanda entry before the upgrade, is not available for the Bitpanda Portfolio, so it now reports every value in EUR. To choose another currency, open the ⋮ menu of the "Bitpanda Portfolio" entry on the Bitpanda integration page and choose "Reconfigure".

price_tracker_exists.title: Bitpanda upgrade: prices to add to the Price Tracker
price_tracker_exists.description:
A Bitpanda Price Tracker was already set up when the upgrade ran, so the prices your old Bitpanda entry tracked were not moved into it. To keep tracking them, add these assets with "Add price tracker" on the "Bitpanda Price Tracker" entry of the Bitpanda integration page:

{assets}

home_assistant_too_old.title: Bitpanda upgrade needs Home Assistant {minimum}
home_assistant_too_old.description: The Bitpanda entry from before the upgrade can only be upgraded on Home Assistant {minimum} or newer, which keeps the history of the renamed sensors. This installation runs Home Assistant {version}, so nothing has been changed. Update Home Assistant; the entry is upgraded at the next start.

portfolio_exists.title: Bitpanda upgrade blocked: a Bitpanda Portfolio is already set up
portfolio_exists.description: The Bitpanda entry "{entry}" from before the upgrade cannot be upgraded: it would become a second Bitpanda Portfolio beside "{portfolio}", and only one can be set up. It has been left unchanged. Delete one of the two entries on the Bitpanda integration page (⋮ → "Delete"). If you keep "{entry}", restart Home Assistant afterwards to upgrade it.

slow_price_interval.title: Bitpanda Price Tracker: prices refresh only every {minutes} minutes
slow_price_interval.description: The Bitpanda Price Tracker tracks {count} assets and needs one request per asset for every refresh. To stay within its request budget, it refreshes their prices only every {minutes} minutes. Track fewer assets for faster updates: delete an asset's device (⋮ on its device page), or a whole group (⋮ on the Bitpanda integration page).

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Manually trigger an immediate refresh of all Bitpanda price and wallet data.
